# Customer workspace launch

The workspace brings customer requests, status updates, and shared materials into one clear place.

## What changes

- A shared view: Everyone sees the latest request and its current owner.
- Faster handoffs: Context travels with the work instead of living in separate messages.
- Clear next steps: Each request shows what needs attention and who can move it forward.

## Availability

The workspace opens to the first customer group next month. Existing workflows continue during the transition.
